_what: A MEASURED career track as pack data — the first one built from posting counts, not a roadmap. A subject is a file: adding this track required no engine edit.
_method: career-claim-audit. Samples: 98 US agentic postings read in full (Simplilearn career-research, Oct 2026) and 1,135 published listings (agentic-engineering-jobs.com, Mar-May 2026, reproducible at their public API). Both Tier 2 snapshots — quoted as counts with their source, never as bare percentages.
_honesty: Posting coverage is NOT proficiency and NOT eligibility. A milestone here still cannot close without an artifact.
